definitions.gloss: no matter how much, however much
definitions.explanation: Expresses that regardless of the degree or amount, the result is the same.

examples.japanese: いくら⟦{食|た}べて→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{太|ふと}らない→太る：01190_futoru⟧。
examples.english: No matter how much I eat, I don't gain weight.

examples.japanese: いくら⟦{待|ま}って→待つ：00469_matsu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{来|こ}なかった→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: No matter how long I waited, they didn't come.

examples.japanese: いくら⟦{説明|せつめい}して→説明：01449_setsumei⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{分|わ}かって→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧⟦もらえない→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: No matter how much I explain, I can't get them to understand.

examples.japanese: いくら⟦{頑張|がんば}って→頑張る：01222_ganbaru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{成績|せいせき}→成績：03379_seiseki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がらなくて→上がる：00615_agaru⟧⟦{悲|かな}しい→悲しい：00783_kanashii⟧。
examples.english: No matter how hard I try, my grades don't improve and it makes me sad.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いくら⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{飽|あ}きない→飽きる：01815_akiru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧{十回|じゅっかい}⟦{以上|いじょう}→以上：01308_ijou⟧⟦{見|み}ている→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: I never get tired of that movie no matter how many times I watch it, so I've seen it more than ten times.

notes:
いくら～て⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧ expresses "no matter how much" - indicating that the result remains the same regardless of the degree or effort.

COMMON PATTERNS:
いくら + verb (て form) + ⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧

EXAMPLES:
- いくら⟦{説明|せつめい}して→説明：01449_setsumei⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: no matter how much I explain
- いくら⟦{食|た}べ→食べる：00396_taberu⟧て⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: no matter how much I eat
- いくら⟦{待|ま}って→待つ：00469_matsu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: no matter how long I wait
- いくら⟦{頑張|がんば}って→頑張る：01222_ganbaru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: no matter how hard I try

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦どんなに→どんなに：03494_donnani⟧～て⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: no matter how (emphasis on manner/degree)
- ⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧～て⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: no matter how many times
- ⟦たとえ→たとえ：03405_tatoe⟧～て⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: even if ~

USAGE:
Often implies frustration or resignation about unchanging results.
